title: Katie Zacharia leaves White House role less than a week after starting - BBC
description: Her public debut as press secretary ended with a flurry of media criticism about her credentials and preparedness.

title: Benjamin Satterley, wrestler known as Pac, died of bronchial asthma - NBC News
description: Benjamin Satterley, known to wrestling fans around the world as Pac, died last month of bronchial asthma, the medical examiner’s office in Cook County, Illinois, confirmed Friday.

title: Palestinians, US journalist attacked in West Bank pogrom: What we know - Al Jazeera
description: Israeli settlers attacked Palestinians harvesting olives and severely beat Washington Post photojournalist Heidi Levine.
